name: Affiliate Amazon Shortcode
author: onodev77

sections.description:
Affiliate Amazon Shortcode is a lightweight yet powerful WordPress plugin that allows you to display Amazon products directly in your posts, pages, or widgets using both the legacy Amazon Product Advertising API v5 and the new Creators API. With this plugin, you can easily integrate Amazon affiliate links, generate rich snippets, and enhance your affiliate marketing strategy without writing any code.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: Amazon Creators API Migration

Amazon requires all affiliates to migrate from PA-API 5.0 to the new Creators API by January 30, 2026. This plugin now supports both APIs for a smooth transition:

  • Creators API (New – Required from Jan 30, 2026): New authentication system, improved security with OAuth 2.0
  • PA-API 5.0 (Legacy): Will be deprecated after January 31, 2026

Ideal for bloggers, affiliate marketers, and e-commerce websites, with Affiliate Amazon Shortcode, you can effectively monetize your website and increase your earnings through the Amazon Affiliate Program.
Try the plugin now and start earning with Amazon.

Features:
– ✅ NEW: Dual API support – Works with both Creators API and legacy PA-API 5.0
– ✅ NEW: Easy API selection in settings – Switch between APIs with one click
– ✅ Display up to 9 products based on a keyword, with customizable layouts.
– ✅ Intuitive settings page for configuring Amazon API credentials and plugin options.
– ✅ Supports multiple marketplaces (e.g., amazon.it, amazon.com).
– ✅ Automatically fetches product images, descriptions, prices, and reviews
– ✅ Flexible customization: number of columns, image size (medium or large), and font sizes for titles and prices.
– ✅ PRO: Template presets (Card, List) and Theme presets (Slate, Blue, Emerald, Amber, Rose, Violet, Indigo, Teal, Zinc). No HTML needed—just pick from dropdowns.

How to Get New Creators API Credentials:

  1. Log in to Amazon Associates Central
  2. Navigate to Tools > Product Advertising API
  3. Click on “Manage Credentials” or “Add Credentials”
  4. Generate new Creators API credentials (Access Key and Secret Key)
  5. Copy these credentials to the plugin settings
  6. Select “Creators API” as your API version

Note: Your old PA-API 5.0 credentials will NOT work with Creators API. You must generate new credentials.

Free vs PRO

Free
– Up to 3 products per keyword
– “Card” template
– Basic style customization (columns, image size, fonts)
– Small on-card watermark text (no external links)

PRO
– No watermark
– Up to 9 products per keyword
– Extra templates.
– Theme presets selector (text/title/price colors) via dropdown
– Priority updates and support

Usage

Once the plugin is configured, use the [affiamsh_amazon keyword="your-keyword"] shortcode in your posts or pages to display Amazon products related to your keyword.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Amazon Product Advertising API (PA-API 5.0) and Amazon Creators API to retrieve product information, such as titles, images, prices, reviews, and discounts.

Data sent to Amazon:
– Keywords (search terms) based on the shortcode.
– Your Amazon API credentials (Access Key, Secret Key, and Partner Tag).

All data is transmitted securely over HTTPS.

Third-Party Services:
– Amazon Creators API: https://affiliate-program.amazon.com/creatorsapi
– Amazon PAAPI Terms of Service: https://webservices.amazon.com/paapi5/documentation/terms.html
– Amazon Privacy Policy: https://www.amazon.com/privacy

Additionally, this plugin includes an optional link to the author’s website, SoftwareApp.it, to provide more information about the plugin and access to premium features.

Data sent to SoftwareApp.it:
– None. The link is purely informational and optional for the user to interact with.

For more details about SoftwareApp.it:
– SoftwareApp Privacy Policy: https://softwareapp.it/privacy-policy
– SoftwareApp Terms of Service: https://softwareapp.it/terms

License

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin and upload it to your WordPress site.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and upload the .zip file.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. Configure your Amazon API credentials in Settings > Amazon API.
  5. IMPORTANT: Select your API version (Creators API recommended)
  6. Use the shortcode [affiamsh_amazon keyword="your keyword"] to display products.
sections.faq:
Do I need to migrate to Creators API?

Yes, Amazon requires migration to Creators API. The old PA-API 5.0 will be deprecated.

How do I get Amazon Creators API credentials?

  1. Log in to Amazon Associates Central
  2. Go to Tools > Product Advertising API
  3. Click “Manage Credentials” and generate new Creators API credentials
  4. Copy them to the plugin settings

Will my old PA-API 5.0 credentials work?

No, you need to generate NEW credentials specifically for Creators API. Your old credentials will only work with the legacy PA-API 5.0 option.

Can I test before migrating?

Yes! The plugin supports both APIs. You can switch between them in the settings to test without affecting your live site.

Why are no products displaying?

Ensure your API credentials, partner tag, and marketplace settings are correct. If using Creators API, make sure you’ve generated new Creators API credentials (not your old PA-API credentials).

Can I customize the product display layout?

Yes, you can configure the number of columns, image sizes, and font sizes for titles and prices in the plugin settings page.

How to upgrade to PRO version?

Open Settings -> Affiliate Amazon Shortcode -> Activate PRO, enter your license key, and click Activate. If you don’t have a key yet, click Purchase PRO to buy one.
